name: WARNING: Pickled Sliced Jalapeño Peppers (Capsaicin & Seeds)
whyItWorks: Pickled jalapeño wheels with hard internal seeds and acidic vinegar brine. Capsaicin activates TRPV1 pain receptors on inflamed intestinal mucosa, triggering hyper-motility, burning diarrhea, and ulcer flare-ups.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Strictly avoid pickled jalapeños, chili peppers, and spicy garnishes on tacos, nachos, and sandwiches. Ask for completely mild preparations.
